svg.desc: Snapshot for anhnam26. 6 public repositories, 9 stars on owned non-fork repositories. Calendar 2025-10-12 to 2026-10-13. Updated 14 Oct 2026 (UTC+7). Red and blue teams play three faster first-to-three matches beneath the calendar, with a central scoreboard and fixed 3–2 results. Each sport lasts 80 seconds including celebration and transition, for a four-minute loop.

svg.title: Pixel Sports Club - red versus blue
svg.desc: Four distinct pixel cartoon athletes play a faster, repeatable four-minute football, basketball and volleyball loop. Each sport lasts 80 seconds including its first-to-three match, fireworks, confetti and court transition. Blue wins football 3-2, red wins basketball 3-2, blue wins volleyball 3-2. Red steals and scores in the third basketball play. The ball rises, spins, glows and morphs as each court transforms. Football and basketball restart with the conceding team; the volleyball point winner serves behind the end line.

g.aria-label: Fireworks and confetti celebrate the winning team
